title: The Morning Mist
template:
The sun rises over the lake, casting a [golden_color] glow across the water. A small wooden boat sits quietly at the dock. The surface of the lake is as smooth as glass.

You step onto the deck and grab a [boating_tool] to help you push off. The ripples spread slowly, disturbing the [calm_adjective] reflection of the trees. A lone bird chirps from a distance. It feels like the whole world is still sleeping.

Deep in the middle of the lake, you spot a [floating_object] floating nearby. You reach out to touch it, feeling the [water_feeling] water on your skin. This is the perfect start to a beautiful day.

blanks.hint: a color or type of light (adjective)
an object used on a boat (noun)
something you might find in water (noun)
